title: Integral representations of projective norm-attaining tensors
summary: We introduce a Bochner integral approach to projective norm attainment in tensor products of Banach spaces by defining the class of integral projective norm-attaining tensors. This framework provides a broader, measure-theoretic approach to the study of projective norm attainment in tensor products of Banach spaces. We show that every integral norm-attaining tensor can be approximated in norm by norm-attaining tensors with finite representations.
